capabilities: Build a quarterly review by compiling daily and weekly notes into consolidated files
Build a weekly review by compiling daily notes with the previous week's review on top
Choose the temp folder where generated review files are saved
Remove empty sections and unmodified template lines from the output
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or flashcard review tool; it merges daily and weekly notes into files for periodic (weekly/quarterly) reflection.
extras: The README discloses that most of the code was written with generative AI (Claude Code); it also states the plugin only modifies files it created in a temp directory.
motivation: The README says it was "created to streamline the review process" so users no longer flip through 13 weekly notes per quarter.
problem: Periodic reviews require manually flipping through many separate daily and weekly notes to get an overview and spot patterns.
summary: Review tool that compiles Daily and Weekly notes from a selected quarter or week into consolidated files for easier periodic reflection.
